recentItems.title: Revealing Mr. Darcy: Bernie Su On How The Lizzie Bennet Diaries Introduced The Iconic Character
recentItems.description:
The Lizzie Bennet Diaries creator Bernie Su talks about how the web series finally revealed the iconic character of Mr. Darcy (played by Daniel Vincent Gordh). He talks about the casting process and how introducing the character led viewers to rewatch the series in a whole new light. The Lizzie Bennet Diaries was based on Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice.

Watch Bernie Su's full interview: http://interviews.televisionacademy.com/interviews/bernie-su
